ios.desc:
Walk first. Scroll later.

FeedFare helps you make room for movement before your next scroll. Choose the apps you want to protect, connect your steps, and turn a walk into earned screen time.

A WALKING RULE YOU CONTROL
Start with 100 steps earning 5 minutes. At that setting, 500 steps earns 25 minutes. Adjust the rule to suit your routine. Changes apply to future credits, and unused minutes carry over.

CHOOSE YOUR APPS. USE YOUR MINUTES.
With Screen Time authorization, select the apps you want to protect. Start a timed session for one app using your earned balance. Your other selected apps stay protected, and protection returns when the session ends. Categories can help you select their current apps; newly installed apps need to be added later. Website blocking is not supported.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Check today's movement, available minutes, daily history, and recent trends. Build a streak with the separate 1,000-step daily milestone, share a milestone when you choose, and set an optional evening reminder.

CONNECTED TO YOUR STEPS
Apple Health provides step counts, including compatible Apple Watch steps after they sync to your iPhone. Motion & Fitness supplies live iPhone steps while FeedFare is open. Background Health updates can arrive later; open the app to refresh your progress. Step permissions are required for the corresponding features.

A FAMILIAR NATIVE EXPERIENCE
A clean SwiftUI interface, light and dark appearances, and Liquid Glass on supported system versions. Requires iOS or iPadOS 17 or later.

FULL APP INCLUDED
This native version has no in-app paywall, trial, or required subscription. Existing FeedFare owners receive the full native app with the update. If you subscribed to an earlier version, manage that subscription separately with Apple: updating or deleting the app does not cancel renewal. Current download pricing is shown on the App Store.

YOUR DATA AND YOUR CHOICES
Your progress and app selections stay in on-device app storage. No FeedFare account is required. This native version includes no advertising or third-party analytics SDK. Device backups follow your Apple settings. Screen Time protection depends on authorization and system behavior.

Terms: https://feedfare.app/terms.html
